NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(CASE WHEN f.version_no IS NOT NULL AND OCTET_LENGTH(f.version_no) > 0 THEN CONCAT('版本 ', f.version_no) END, CONCAT('^[', CONVERT(UNHEX('090A0B0C0D20C2A0E19A80E28080E28081E28082E28083E28084E28085E28086E28087E28088E28089E2808AE280A8E280A9E280AFE2819FE38080EFBBBF') USING utf8mb4), ']+|[', CONVERT(UNHEX('090A0B0C0D20C2A0E19A80E28080E28081E28082E28083E28084E28085E28086E28087E28088E28089E2808AE280A8E280A9E280AFE2819FE38080EFBBBF') USING utf8mb4), ']+$'), ''), '')) AS detail, '待签收' AS status_label, f.published_time AS created_at, NULL AS due_at, CAST(f.id AS CHAR) AS controlled_file_id, CAST(d.id AS CHAR) AS distribution_id FROM dcc_controlled_file_distribution_recipient p JOIN dcc_controlled_file_distribution d ON d.id = p.distribution_id AND d.tenant_id = #{q.tenantId} AND d.deleted = 0 JOIN dcc_controlled_file f ON f.id = d.controlled_file_id AND f.tenant_id = #{q.tenantId} AND f.deleted = 0 WHERE p.tenant_id = #{q.tenantId} AND p.deleted = 0 AND p.user_id = #{q.userId} AND p.acknowledged_at IS NULL AND d.distribution_medium = 'PUBLIC_FOLDER' AND f.status IN ('ACTIVE','SUPERSEDED','OBSOLETE')
